name: The Carlton Milano
positioning: Rocco Forte's The Carlton on Via Senato in Milan's Quadrilatero della Moda, with Fulvio Pierangelini's classic dishes, the Cafe Floretta winter garden, The Carlton Bar and an Irene Forte Spa
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in Milan's fashion district
Guests who care about interior design

facts.text: The hotel's address is Via Senato 5, Milan 20121.
The hotel is in the heart of Milan's Quadrilatero della Moda.
The interiors pair Milanese style with the warmth and intimacy of a private residence.
Each Junior Suite features curated artworks and furnishings.
The rooms use fine Italian materials.
Spiga serves Italian cuisine on Via della Spiga.
The hotel has an Irene Forte Spa.
The spa's treatments combine botanicals with advanced technology, with roots in Sicily.

highlights.text: The fine-dining restaurant serves Fulvio Pierangelini's classic dishes.
The suites were designed by Olga Polizzi, Paolo Moschino and Philip Vergeylen.
Cafe Floretta is a winter garden.
The Forte Suites are individually designed and have views and terraces.
The Carlton Bar serves cocktails with a twist at aperitivo hour.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes parking is limited in the busy city-center location.
WhataHotel notes the premium pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.

sources.title: The Carlton Milan - Rocco Forte Hotels
